# #386 — QMD-1: Restore the qmd sync as a standalone scheduled job (orphaned when session-wrap was removed)

State: OPEN
Author: rodaddy
Labels: enhancement
Created: 2026-07-25T00:19:15Z
Updated: 2026-07-25T00:19:15Z

---

Parent: #342
Program: #320

## Problem

qmd is already wired into Open Brain recall across 22 source files
(`src/tools/search-all.ts`, `src/tools/repo-facts.ts`, the context-pack
repo-facts sections, `scripts/promote-qmd-repo-facts.ts`,
`scripts/core01-qmd-bootstrap.sh`). The integration works.

Nothing updates the index. Measured 2026-07-24:

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Files indexed | 52,337 |
| Vectors | 213,950 |
| Index size | 2.2 GB |
| Last updated | **39 days** |
| `open-brain` collection | **absent** |

Every context-pack repo-facts section has therefore been serving a stale and
incomplete view of the codebase.

**Root cause:** the qmd sync used to run as part of session-wrap. Session-wrap
was removed and took the sync with it. This was orphaned, not merely
unscheduled — and it failed silently, because a stale index still returns
results, just old ones.

Session-wrap was also the wrong home:

- frequency tied to session count, not to code changing
- ran ~30x/day when nothing had changed
- ran mid-flow, competing with active work
- failures disappeared into session noise

## Scope

- Standalone machine-owned scheduled job at 04:00 local, detached from any
  human session: `qmd update` followed by `qmd embed`.
- launchd (macOS), consistent with `com.rico.open-brain`.
- Log last-run time, files indexed, files updated, vectors embedded.
- Non-zero exit on failure so the failure is visible rather than silent.

## Out of scope

- Collection triage (see QMD-2).
- Folding this into a dream/deep stage. Worth revisiting once the dream stages
  exist, since a nightly mechanical refresh is deep-stage-shaped work, but the
  standalone job is independently useful and should not block on that design.

## Verification

- Job registered and fires on schedule.
- `qmd status` shows an updated timestamp within 24h.
- A search for a symbol added the previous day returns the file.
